integrity: The formulas are proved from the two stochastic recurrences. The bundled exact-rational replay checks finite horizons as a consistency test and does not replace the all-horizon proof. No independent audit or independent validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Exact for a one-dimensional cocoercive linear root problem at the reflected endpoint with independent additive minibatch noise and the source algorithms' coefficients; no universal worst-case claim is made for other nonexpansive maps, correlated or state-dependent noise, variable batches, or different step choices.
title: Exact persistent-noise separation between stochastic OHM and Dual-OHM at reflection
